# Agenda-Intelligence.md

A compact markdown protocol for turning public agenda into decision-ready risk analysis.

Core rule: do not summarize the news. Identify what changed, who is affected, what incentives shifted, what remains unknown, and what to watch next.

Repository: https://github.com/vassiliylakhonin/Agenda-Intelligence-md
Skill path: skills/agenda-intelligence/SKILL.md

Recommended use:
- policy and geopolitical analysis;
- sanctions and compliance monitoring;
- trade and regulatory risk briefs;
- founder/investor operating-context notes;
- red-team checks on confident narratives.

Related full memo skill: https://github.com/vassiliylakhonin/global-think-tank-analyst
Use Agenda-Intelligence.md for lightweight agenda triage; use global-think-tank-analyst for full policy-risk memos.

Regional lens packs:
- Central Asia + Caspian: skills/agenda-intelligence/references/regional/central-asia-caspian.md
- Middle East: skills/agenda-intelligence/references/regional/middle-east.md
- European Union: skills/agenda-intelligence/references/regional/eu.md

Top-level protocol: Agenda-Intelligence.md
Role: sits beside files such as AGENTS.md as a conditional public-agenda reasoning layer.
Use it only for news, policy, regulation, sanctions, geopolitics, trade, markets, conflict, or strategic-risk analysis.

Before/after examples:
- examples/before-after/eu-ai-act.md
- examples/before-after/red-sea-shipping.md
- examples/before-after/sanctions-routing.md
- examples/before-after/evaluation-rubric.md

Adoption guide: ADOPTION.md

AnalysisBank: analysis-bank/README.md
